content.value: The storage of a food & beverage company receives daily loads of items A from the manufacturing plant and shipments are made once a week. Information about this item is given in the following table. The company is considering purchasing a tractor that pulls 3 trucks, a forklift truck or a hand truck for use in transporting. Pertinent sizes and costs for these are listed in table below. The loading and unloading cost includes not only the cost for loading and unloading but also for making the return trip to pick up another load. Determine the least expensive method for transporting
